profile.name: Ackermans & Van Haaren NV
profile.summary: Ackermans & Van Haaren NV engages in marine engineering and contracting, private banking, real estate, energy and resources, and growth capital businesses worldwide. The Marine Engineering & Contracting segment engages in the marine construction activities, including dredging and civil works on water, as well as offshore activities in the areas of renewable energy, oil and gas, soil and sludge remediation, and aggregate and mineral extraction; real estate development, multitechnics, and construction and renovation activities; and development of port projects and related industrial zones, as well as offshore wind farms. The Private Banking segment offers discretionary asset management services for private clients; and specialized advisory banking services for entrepreneurs and liberal professionals, as well as financing and financial leasing services for cars, equipment, charging stations, and bicycles. The Real Estate segment develops mixed real estate projects, including redevelopment of iconic buildings and new constructions and residential, retail, and office properties. The Energy & Resources segment produces crude palm oil and bananas; offers hybrid palm oil seeds; and manufactures cement. The AvH & Growth Capital segment provides engineering and solutions in production process automation; validation and compliance services; compact biogas installation; specialty chemicals; and logistics services for rail, port and road transport, and intermodal transport, and warehousing. It also offers crop and food protection products and deals and leases commercial vehicles, as well as distributes aftermarket products. The company also develops medical devices and medicines for the treatment of cancer and genetic diseases. Ackermans & Van Haaren NV was founded in 1876 and is based in Antwerp, Belgium.
profile.summary_fr: Ackermans & Van Haaren NV se consacre à l'ingénierie et à la sous-traitance maritimes, à la banque privée, à l'immobilier, à l'énergie et aux ressources, ainsi qu'aux activités de capital de croissance dans le monde entier. Le secteur de l’ingénierie et des contrats maritimes exerce des activités de construction marine, y compris des travaux de dragage et de génie civil sur l’eau, ainsi que des activités offshore dans les domaines des énergies renouvelables, du pétrole et du gaz, de l’assainissement des sols et des boues, de l’extraction d’agrégats et de minéraux; développement immobilier, multitechniques et activités de construction et de rénovation; et développement de projets portuaires et de zones industrielles connexes, ainsi que de parcs éoliens. Le secteur Banque privée offre des services discrétionnaires de gestion d’actifs pour les clients privés; et des services bancaires de conseil spécialisés pour les entrepreneurs et les professionnels libéraux, ainsi que des services de financement et de crédit-bail pour les voitures, les équipements, les bornes de recharge et les vélos.
